fields.description: Weekly issue containing local commentary and humor about Miami’s post-boom economy, city commission affairs, and civic projects. Coverage includes discussion of convention plans, airport planning, street lighting and traffic hazards, waterfront fire protection following a fire at Fisher slip, and political disputes involving a Republican committeeman and city publicity funds. Also includes items on rents and tourism expectations, Prohibition-era liquor enforcement, sports coverage and criticism (baseball and boxing), entertainment notices, and extensive local advertising.
